info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Service Lookup API facilitates the retrieval of banking consumer service information based on specific parameters. By leveraging the unique identifier provided in the URL, consumers can access detailed data regarding bank drafts and related services. This API is essential for developers integrating banking solutions, allowing applications to query service details directly. Typical users include financial institutions, application developers, and third-party service providers looking to enhance their offerings with consumer banking functionalities.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific bank draft.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the information of a bank draft using its unique identifier. The response provides detailed data about the bank draft, including its status and associated account information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving bank drafts. The request must contain the necessary parameters as defined in the schema to ensure the correct processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the bank draft details are returned.

GetConsumerServiceByParam1Request.description: This schema represents a request body for the GET operation related to bank drafts in the consumer services.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer.

serviceRequestId.description: The unique identifier for the service request.

productCode.description: The code of the product associated with the bank draft.

amount.description: The monetary value associated with the bank draft.

requestedDate.description: The date when the service was requested in ISO 8601 format.

version.description: The version number of the bank draft record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the record was last updated in ISO 8601 format.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetConsumerServiceByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for fetching bank draft operations.

value.description: The numerical value of the amount.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount, following ISO 4217 format.

Amount.description: Represents an amount of money with currency.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier to track the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated in ISO 8601 format.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Contains additional metadata about the response.

x-endpoint-id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

x-runtime-app.description: Version identifier of the application runtime environment.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, typically sent in the Authorization header of the HTTP request. It requires a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) for authorization, ensuring secure access control.
